verses.gurmukhi: ਵਣਿ ਵਣਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਵਣਾਸਪਤਿ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਬਾਝੁ ਨ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਹੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: van van vaas vanaasapat cha(n)dhan baajh na cha(n)dhan hoiee|

en.bdb: The forests are replete with vegetation but without sandalwood, the fragrance of sandal does not occur in it.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਰਬਤਿ ਪਰਬਤਿ ਅਸਟ ਧਾਤੁ ਪਾਰਸ ਬਾਝੁ ਨ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਸੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: parabat parabat asaT dhaat paaras baajh na ka(n)chan soiee|

en.bdb: Minerals are there on all the mountain but without the philosopher's stone they do not transform into gold.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਾਰਿ ਵਰਣਿ ਛਿਅ ਦਰਸਨਾ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਾਧ ਨ ਕੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: chaar varan chhia dharasanaa saadhasa(n)gat vin saadh na koiee|

en.bdb: None among the four varnas and the scholars of the six philosophies can become (true) sadhu without the company of saints.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਅਵੇਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਜਾਣੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: gur upadhes aves kar gurmukh saadhasa(n)gat jaanoiee|

en.bdb: Charged by the teachings of the Guru, gurmukhs understand the importance of the company of the saints.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਲੀਣੁ ਹੋਇ ਪਿਰਮ ਪਿਆਲਾ ਅਪਿਉ ਪਿਓਈ।
verses.translit_en: sabadh surat liv leen hoi piram piaalaa apiau pioiee|

en.bdb: Then, they getting the consciousness attuned to the Word, quaff the cup of nectar of loving devotion.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਉਨਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਦੁਬਲੇ ਦੇਹ ਬਿਦੇਹ ਸਨੇਹ ਸਥੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: man unaman tan dhubale dheh bidheh saneh sathoiee|

en.bdb: The mind now reaching the highest stage of spiritual realisation (turiya) and becoming subtle stabilises in the love of the Lord.
Gurmukhs beholding the invisible Lord receive the fruits of that pleasure.
